refuted.correction: 06:45 delivery is PROVEN, not unknown. It is the ONLY surface in the federation with a delivery receipt at all.

refuted.claim: DEPLOYMENT_DRIFT label beats drift:false; reason_code defaults override measurement.
refuted.verdict: WRONG MECHANISM — the instinct is right, the location is wrong
refuted.measured: tools.py:163 returns the payload UNTOUCHED unless _payload_has_deployment_drift() is true. All of _force_no_mutate / _force_verdict_keys / _force_nine / _force_standing sit inside that guard. So reason_code = reason_code or 'DEPLOYMENT_DRIFT' (line 224) fires only AFTER drift was measured. It names a measured drift; it does not substitute for measurement.
refuted.the_real_mechanism: line 140: `if sub.get('state') == 'DEGRADED' or sub.get('drift') is True`. Here a DEGRADED LABEL is accepted as equivalent to a MEASURED drift flag. That is the actual label-beats-measurement point, and it is one token wide: an OR where the two sides are not the same kind of thing.
refuted.note: F13 identified this correctly earlier (state=DEGRADED producing drift even when drift=false). The external audit restated a true finding at the wrong address, which would have sent a fixer to patch line 224 — the one line that is already correct.

refuted.measured: routing for the two live paths IS proven: 06:30 -> AAA by env-var override, 06:45 -> DM by hardcoded id plus a SENT receipt. The three ALPHA-ZEN jobs are UNPROVEN because they have never fired — which is a different statement from 'routing is unproven'.

the_finding_the_audit_stumbled_near.statement: The 06:45 receipt proves SENT but carries msg_id=None. It cannot prove WHAT was sent.
the_finding_the_audit_stumbled_near.why_it_matters: This is E13 in the delivery layer. A receipt that does not bind to the artifact it carried proves a channel, not an event. F13's own arrow protocol already requires TELEGRAM ACCEPTED to name a message id — this receipt cannot satisfy that arrow.
the_finding_the_audit_stumbled_near.consequence: The audit's CONCLUSION was wrong (delivery is not unknown) but its discomfort was pointing at something real: delivery is proven, CONTENT BINDING is not.

Receipt content-binding flagged as a real gap: msg_id=None means SENT is proven and payload is not.
DEPLOYMENT_DRIFT real mechanism localised to tools.py:140 (state=='DEGRADED' accepted as drift proof), NOT line 224.
Kernel contradiction elevated: it is upstream of CHRON because any CHRON signal reading kernel state inherits a mislabelled verdict.
The 'clock-driven vs context-driven' framing adopted as the correct description of the delivery architecture.
